operator_go: issue 55, 2026-09-30: 'P1-P3 can all use SiGeC + dopant'
question: For the nanostructured SiGeC + light-dopant design space, how many runs does a campaign need to (i) sample every two-factor combination, (ii) stay complete when runs are lost, (iii) recover the Ge-saving screening decision, and (iv) where should follow-up runs go? Compared against random batches and one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) of equal or natural size.
response_model: The committed SiGeC lattice-thermal-conductivity model (nano_sigec/analyze_sigec.py: almaBTE per-mode host data, ledger seq 45, plus gray grain boundary, substitutional-C point-defect or SiC-nanoinclusion scattering, dopant point-defect scattering; converged MACE size misfit, ledger seq 55). It plays the role of the expensive measurement: every design sees only the runs it selects. No new BTE or MD runs.

designs.CA1: strength-2 covering array: every level pair of every two factors at least once; greedy construction (as p3_strain/design_strain_batch.py), 20 construction seeds, the smallest kept as the reference and all 20 used as replicates
designs.CA2: 2-fold strength-2 covering (every pair at least twice), built by extending CA1; the 1-erasure-tolerant variant
designs.RND_n: uniform random subsets of the full factorial without replacement, n = |CA1| and n = |CA2|, 200 replicates each
designs.OFAT: one-factor-at-a-time around the baseline (x=0.2, y_C=0.01, SiC_R25nm, d=0.3 um, none, 700 K): 1 + sum(levels-1) = 23 runs; single deterministic design

surrogate: ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=300, min_samples_leaf=1, random_state=0) on features [x, y_C, is_substitutional, log10(R_nm) (0 for substitutional), log10(d_um), is_B, is_P, T/1000], target ln kappa_L; carbon-form features set to a fixed 'no carbon' code when y_C = 0

metrics.pair_coverage: fraction of all two-factor level pairs present in the batch
metrics.log_rmse: RMSE of surrogate ln kappa_L over the full 9000-point factorial
metrics.screening_regret: Ge-saving decision: among full-factorial points with x_Ge <= 0.2 and T = 1100 K, the surrogate's argmin; regret = true kappa_L(pick) / true minimum - 1
metrics.factor_ranking: permutation importance of the six factors (grouped carbon-form features) on the full factorial, from the batch-trained surrogate

erasure_test: for CA1, CA2 and RND at |CA2|: delete k in {1, 2, 3} rows uniformly at random, 500 trials each; report fraction of trials with complete pair coverage and median screening regret after refit

transversal_followup.uncertain_hyperedges: after fitting on the reference CA2 batch: every two-factor level cell over the four material factors (x_Ge, y_C, carbon_form, d_eff) with y_C > 0 cells only for carbon_form pairs; cell uncertainty = mean over its grid points of the per-tree standard deviation of ln kappa_L; uncertain set = top 20% of cells
transversal_followup.transversal: greedy minimum hitting set: repeatedly add the full-factorial point hitting the most not-yet-hit uncertain cells (ties broken by larger predicted uncertainty) until all are hit; size m is its natural size
baselines: m points of largest pointwise per-tree standard deviation
transversal_followup.metric: log_rmse and screening_regret after refitting on CA2 + follow-up

predictions.P3-1: |CA1| <= 40 (lower bound 30 = 6 x 5) and uniform random batches of size |CA1| cover < 90% of level pairs on median
predictions.P3-2: median screening regret over the 20 CA1 replicates <= median over the 200 random batches of size |CA1|
predictions.P3-3: under k = 1 deletion, CA2 keeps complete pair coverage in 100% of trials and CA1 in < 50%
predictions.P3-4: the price of 1-erasure tolerance |CA2| / |CA1| lies between 1.6 and 2.2
predictions.P3-5: the transversal follow-up gives lower log_rmse than the median of equal-size random follow-ups
predictions.P3-6: materials check: the CA2-trained surrogate ranks dopant last among the six factors by permutation importance (the relative order of carbon form and y_C is reported, not predicted)
predictions.P3-7: OFAT (23 runs) has higher screening regret than the median random batch of |CA1| runs

declared_limits: the response is a physics model, not a measurement: the study measures design properties on a known response surface; P3's measured campaign remains the strain batch (p3_strain)
the SiC scattering strength at R <= 5 nm is uncertain by a factor of about 2 (stiffness vs density contrast); the density-contrast surface is evaluated as a sensitivity check
run cost is treated as uniform across the space
deviation_policy: any change to factors, designs, surrogate, metrics or predictions after registration is a new pre-registration; infrastructure fixes are recorded as ledger deviations
